item.title: 20 coal cars derail near B.C. wetland, says ministry
item.description: A spokesperson for Burlington Northern and Santa Fe Railway said the train derailed Thursday at around 9:13 p.m. in Surrey, B.C.

item.title: US stocks soar to their best day since May as the Dow tops 50,000 and bitcoin stops plunging
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — The U.S. stock market roared back on Friday, as technology stocks recovered much of their losses from earlier in the week and bitcoin halted its plunge, at least for now. The S&P 500 rallied 2% for its best day since May.

item.title: Canada, U.S. stock markets rebound on Friday, with the Dow Jones topping 50K
item.description: TORONTO — Stock markets in Canada and the U.S. saw gains on Friday as the Dow Jones industrial average topped 50,000 for the first time to end the week.

item.description: Business group urges B.C. to boost in-province supply chains to unlock trade opportunities

item.title: Bodies found in area in Mexico where search is on for 10 missing workers from Canadian mine
item.description: MEXICO CITY (AP) — Mexican authorities on Friday announced the discovery of bodies and remains in the northwestern state of Sinaloa in an area of an ongoing search for 10 missing workers from a Canadian gold and silver mine.

item.title: B.C. seeks to appeal DRIPA ruling in top court, says 'core democratic values' at risk
item.description: VICTORIA — A First Nations leader says the British Columbia government wants amendments that propose a "gutting" of its own reconciliation legislation.
